tagline: PVH Corp. is one of the largest global apparel companies in the world, with over 140 years of history.
hero_kpi_rationale: Consolidated revenue is the principal indicator of the company's size and overall performance in the apparel sector. It reflects PVH's ability to sell its flagship brands in the global marketplace.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales generated by the company.
kpis.description: PVH's revenue for fiscal year 2025 reached 8.95 billion dollars, up from 8.65 billion dollars in fiscal year 2024.
kpis.signal: Moderate revenue growth driven by core brands.

kpis.name: International Revenue %
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue generated outside the United States.
kpis.description: Over 70% of PVH's revenue is generated outside the United States, underscoring its global presence.
kpis.signal: Strong reliance on international markets for growth.

kpis.name: Tommy Hilfiger & Calvin Klein Revenue %
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue generated by flagship brands TOMMY HILFIGER and Calvin Klein.
kpis.description: TOMMY HILFIGER and Calvin Klein brands accounted for over 95% of the company's revenue in 2025 and 2024, demonstrating their strategic importance.
kpis.signal: Revenue concentration on two core brands.

kpis.name: Associates
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: PVH employs approximately 26,000 people worldwide, supporting its global operations.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount, indicating consolidated human resources management strategy.

kpis.name: Tariff Impact on Gross Profit 2026
kpis.explanation: Estimated net financial impact of tariffs on the company's gross profit for fiscal year 2026.
kpis.description: PVH anticipates a negative net impact of approximately 195 million dollars on its gross profit for fiscal year 2026 due to tariffs, including a gross charge of approximately 195 million dollars partially offset by mitigation actions.
kpis.signal: Significant negative impact of tariffs on projected profitability.

kpis.name: Goodwill and Intangible Asset Impairment
kpis.explanation: Non-cash charge related to the impairment of goodwill and intangible assets value.
kpis.description: PVH recorded a non-cash impairment charge of 480 million dollars in the first quarter of 2025, primarily due to a significant increase in discount rates during goodwill and intangible asset impairment testing.
kpis.signal: Significant exceptional charge reflecting asset revaluation due to increased discount rates.

kpis.name: Growth Driver 5 Actions Costs
kpis.explanation: Costs incurred as part of the operating model simplification initiative.
kpis.description: PVH incurred 93 million dollars in pre-tax costs in 2025 related to its Growth Driver 5 Actions initiative to simplify its operating model, primarily severance costs. The initiative generated annualized cost savings of over 200 million dollars.
kpis.signal: Investment in restructuring to optimize operations and generate long-term savings.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of 8.95 billion dollars in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Divestiture of Intimate Apparel Brands (Warner's, Olga, True Co.)
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by divested brands prior to their sale in November 2023.
kpis.description: Warner's, Olga and True Co. businesses were sold to Basic Resources on November 27, 2023 for net proceeds of 156 million dollars, generating an aggregate pre-tax net gain of 13 million dollars, plus an additional gain of 10 million dollars in the first quarter of 2024 following accelerated bonus realization.
kpis.signal: Strategic divestiture completed in November 2023 to focus on core brands.

kpis.name: Tommy Hilfiger Employment Agreement Amendment
kpis.explanation: Costs related to the amendment of Tommy Hilfiger's employment agreement in September 2024.
kpis.description: PVH recorded pre-tax costs of 51 million dollars in the third quarter of 2024 following the amendment of Mr. Tommy Hilfiger's employment agreement, including a cash buyout of a portion of the future payment obligation.
kpis.signal: Exceptional cost related to key personnel management decision.

risks.title: Impact of tariffs on gross profit margin
risks.score_rationale: Risk is cited first among factors impacting 2025 gross profit margin, with a negative effect of 80 basis points in 2025 and projected 215 basis points in 2026. Language is alarming ('significant negative impact'). Severity is exacerbated by regulatory uncertainty and expanding scope of risk. High weighting for macroeconomic risks in the fashion sector.

risks.title: Deterioration in sales quality in EMEA
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned as a deliberate strategy in 2023-2024 to 'improve sales quality,' but resulting in repeated revenue declines in wholesale and DTC segments in EMEA. Language shifts toward sustained concern, with impacts on growth. Industry category weighted at medium level.

risks.title: Revenue reduction following divestiture of Heritage Intimate Apparel Brands
risks.score_rationale: Direct impact of 2% on 2024 revenue decline, with repeated mention in Americas and wholesale segments. Risk is consolidated in financial statements and affects revenue structure. Factual language but revealing of structural transformation. Medium weighting for divestiture risk.

risks.title: Volatility of results related to pension plans
risks.score_rationale: Document emphasizes 'significant volatility' linked to actuarial gains and losses, with risk of substantial losses in case of discount rate variations. Explicit mention of 2026 uncertainty. Cautious but concerned language. Recurring and uncontrollable risk, weighted heavily.

risks.title: Calvin Klein delivery delays
risks.score_rationale: Cited as cause of additional costs (freight, markdowns) in 2025, impacting gross profit margin. Explicit mention of operational disruptions. Although presented as isolated, the effect is significant (tens of millions). Industry category, high severity for flagship brand.

risks.title: Transition to lower-margin wholesale model
risks.score_rationale: Recapture of categories previously under license (e.g., women's) weighs on gross profit margin (negative 50 basis points in 2025, negative 50 basis points expected in 2026). Repeated mention as structural factor. Neutral language but concerning data. Major strategic operational risk.

risks.title: Dependence on Latin American performance through joint ventures
risks.score_rationale: Revenue from joint venture investments (notably Mexico) cited, but without specific risk detail. Lack of direct control and dependence on partners raise moderate risk of competition or misalignment. Discrete but implicit mention. Competition category, medium weighting.

ai_positioning.summary: PVH Corp. does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
